summary: Implemented Graph.cbd in rdflib/graph.py (last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a docstring covering the three CBD rules, and added test/test_graph_cbd.py (CbdTestCase with six tests covering rules 1-2 counts, typed/untyped reifiers, incoming reification, blank-node non-expansion in reification, blank-node cycles, and source immutability). Nothing was run, per instructions; expected counts were verified by hand against a self-written Turtle fixture. Nothing committed.
